verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides APIs (Card Expenses API, Bills API) explicitly designed to let expenses/invoices be pulled and marked as synced into an ERP or accounting system, plus webhooks for real-time event notifications that could drive syncing. However, there's no evidence of a native, pre-built, named integration with common accounting platforms (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite) — the sync is only achievable via custom API/webhook development, not an out-of-the-box automatic sync. Missing for 10: named accounting-software connectors, evidence of automatic (not developer-built) sync workflows, and independent confirmation of accounting integration usage.
